chunks.text:
[Intro]
{the harbour bell tolls once, harp ripples outward like the boats pushing off, and the lead lifts the opening phrase of the waltz over a held chord that leads into the theme}
positive_styles: warm accordion-like pulse-wave lead singing a processional waltz melody
flowing harp arpeggios like lantern light on water over a lush string pad
deep tolling harbour bell on phrase starts
rocking waltz bass like a moored hull
